public_case.title: Rare: anomalous coronary origin discovered during evaluation

symptoms: Exertional chest discomfort and near-syncope during intense exercise.
No known coronary disease. Symptoms during exertion require careful risk assessment; the case is not intended to reassure from age alone.
history: Family history and sudden-death history must be specifically asked

reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: specialist review is requested and case remains open pending anatomic risk characterization.
learning_objectives: Recognize that rare anatomy can be clinically important.
Use appropriate imaging to define course.
Avoid reassurance based solely on age or resting tests.
